rationale: restore_checkpoint() forgot to reset self.global_step alongside epoch/tokens when cfg.restore_dataloader=False, so resumed run keeps the checkpoint's step counter (e.g., 50000) and skips warmup. Detection reads global_step right after restore and asserts ==0 (single value, anti-example 12: value_equality not completeness). Layer is schema_topo_precond: single-rank check but the assertion only applies under precond cfg.restore_dataloader=False. P1 because step is a standard Tier 0 trace field. check_stage=init: bug visible immediately after restore_checkpoint, before training step 0 (anti-example 10).
